member.name: M:Meziantou.Framework.Versioning.SemanticVersionRange.ParseNuGet(System.String)
member.summary: Parses a version range in NuGet format.
member.remarks:
Supported formats:
1.0.0 - Minimum version inclusive (>=1.0.0)
[1.0.0] - Exact version (==1.0.0)
(1.0.0,) - Greater than (>1.0.0)
[1.0.0,) - Greater than or equal (>=1.0.0)
(,1.0.0] - Less than or equal (<=1.0.0)
(,1.0.0) - Less than (<1.0.0)
[1.0.0,2.0.0] - Range inclusive on both ends
[1.0.0,2.0.0) - Range inclusive on min, exclusive on max
(1.0.0,2.0.0) - Range exclusive on both ends
member.param: The string to parse.
member.exception: The value is not a valid NuGet version range.

member.name: M:Meziantou.Framework.Versioning.SemanticVersionRange.ParseNpm(System.String)
member.summary: Parses a version range in npm format.
member.remarks:
Supported formats:
1.0.0 - Exact version
=1.0.0 - Exact version
>1.0.0 - Greater than
>=1.0.0 - Greater than or equal
<1.0.0 - Less than
<=1.0.0 - Less than or equal
>=1.0.0 <2.0.0 - Range with multiple constraints (space-separated)
~1.2.3 - Tilde range: allows patch-level changes (>=1.2.3 <1.3.0)
~1.2 - Tilde range (>=1.2.0 <1.3.0)
~1 - Tilde range (>=1.0.0 <2.0.0)
^1.2.3 - Caret range: allows changes that don't modify left-most non-zero (>=1.2.3 <2.0.0)
^0.2.3 - Caret range (>=0.2.3 <0.3.0)
^0.0.3 - Caret range (>=0.0.3 <0.0.4)
1.0.0 - 2.0.0 - Hyphen range (>=1.0.0 <=2.0.0)
* - Any version
1.x - X-range: any minor/patch (>=1.0.0 <2.0.0)
1.2.x - X-range: any patch (>=1.2.0 <1.3.0)
member.param: The string to parse.
member.exception: The value is not a valid npm version range.
